payload.text: Scope of Table 5-1 note 1 differs between languages: the governing Arabic note applies the height limits to all permanent and temporary structures including stacks, cranes and construction equipment, whereas English note (1) of Appendix B reads 'These limits apply to all permanent structures, including stacks.' Under ADD-03 Section 7.2 the Arabic governs, so crane and lifting plans and construction methodology must respect the zone limits (25 m Zone A, 40 m Zone B); this bears on the crane and lifting content of the Technical Proposal.
